name: archived singular geometry has all sixteen exact gates
detail: Replayed the original exact ray, radial, incidence, derivative and endpoint algebra. The regularity, frame and analytic asymptotic proofs remain separate.

name: frame ray limits differ and rank volume endpoint needs L at least three
detail: Two axis limits of J n n^T J^T differ. G(3,3)=405/68; G(3,2)=60/17 is smaller, retaining the theorem's N,L>=3 domain.

name: Gram null decoupling preserves the physical operator
detail: Exact nonorthogonal rank-two synthesis verifies null decoupling and G^+B, and rejects using the raw overlap B as coordinate action. No general history closure.

name: Hermitian Ritz residual bounds the nearest exact eigenvalue
detail: A rational three-level Hermitian model verifies the squared residual enclosure; this is not a rerun of the saved B6 numerical campaign or an all-coupling enclosure.

name: positive matrix atom controls retain full rank and an empty annulus
detail: 29 positive three-component finite measures have total I, atom floor I/3, and a fixed empty annulus. Weak convergence and Portmanteau are analytic, not this test.

name: conditional spectral floor accepts noncommuting matrices
detail: A and B do not commute; lambda_min((A+B)/2)>=3/2, the average of their floors. This checks a finite instance, not a coarse-marginal Hessian identification.

name: all twelve nondegenerate staple incidence controls pass
detail: Every selected link belongs to its own incident staple only in twelve exact periodic cases. This asserts coordinate incidence, not statistical independence.

name: positive sector transfer retains Laurent coefficients
detail: All coefficients of z^3 tr(T(z)^3) are nonnegative exactly. General gauge-theory positivity and final Fourier cancellation are not supplied.

name: VSU action derivatives and both energy asymptotics are exact
detail: The constitutive primitive, radial Hessian factor, cubic small-gradient and quadratic large-gradient limits hold exactly. Bounded-domain existence is analytic.

name: determinant reduction retains every row permutation sign
detail: All three symbolic row cases pass; the historical middle-row formula needs -1.

name: moving adjoint force retains its own derivative
detail: The missing Ad_g dX term is nonzero in an exact rotating force example. This repairs the differentiation rule, not the archive's subsequent rank/tube theorem.

name: same coupling score covariance is a positive pair sum
detail: The equal-score covariance numerator is an exact positive weighted square sum. The SU3 sphere character integration and infinite-series limit are analytic.

name: SU3 twice wound covariance and crossed Haar coefficient are negative
detail: Character orthogonality gives normalized covariance -1/18 for a twice-wound loop, and the balanced rank-three crossed Weingarten coefficient is -1/24. Neither is an elementary-plaquette counterexample.

name: literal Balaban corner paths have exact fourth order trace defect
detail: Replayed exact Q(i) matrix-log/exp arithmetic for SU2 on 12x12, L=3: degrees 0..3 vanish and epsilon^4=4/81. Distinct gauge-invariant traces exclude reflection equivariance modulo coarse gauge for this convention.
